item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 FINAL #SLPRSD
Issued at 08:30 PM 21 October 2026

All Thunderstorm Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated. However, all are still advised to continue monitoring for updates.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
Issued at 03:25 PM 21 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NorthernSamar(SilvinoLobos, LasNavas, Allen, Lavezares, Rosario, SanJose, Bobon, Biri, Victoria, Capul, SanAntonio, SanIsidro), #OrientalMindoro(Pinamalayan and Socorro) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro(Bulalacao, Mansalay, Roxas, Bongabong, Bansud and Gloria) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
item.description:

Keep monitoring for updates.
